# Shared cases: how a cancelled download settles its row.
#
# Replayed by both implementations, so they cannot drift apart:
#   - native/linthra_core/src/download_settle_cases_test.rs (Rust)
#   - test/core/services/download_settle_cases_test.dart (Dart)
#
# One case per line, fields separated by a single TAB. `#` starts a comment.
#
#   <row>  <committed copy>  <status to set>
#
# row:       - (no row) | queued | downloading | downloaded | failed
# committed: nothing | preCache | download
# result:    - (leave the row) | notDownloaded | downloaded

-	nothing	-
-	preCache	-
-	download	-
queued	nothing	notDownloaded
queued	preCache	notDownloaded
queued	download	downloaded
downloading	nothing	notDownloaded
downloading	preCache	notDownloaded
downloading	download	downloaded
downloaded	nothing	notDownloaded
downloaded	preCache	notDownloaded
downloaded	download	-
failed	nothing	notDownloaded
failed	preCache	notDownloaded
failed	download	downloaded
